title: Define explicit capability and option portfolio
description: After the evaluation harness, extend provider-neutral contracts only for demonstrated needs: freshness/date ranges, source types, semantic vs keyword intent, social handles/date windows, and provider-specific option warnings. Keep ordinary calls single-provider while allowing explicit provider selection and future opt-in comparison.

logs.msg: Defined the long-term capability policy: keep current public request options small; pass X operators through explicit X queries; add generic date/source/social fields only after provider conformance proves shared semantics. Official X API is complementary to xAI and now has a separate implementation task. No hidden fan-out.
